quote: Our proposed task consists of 2D grid puzzles through which a line must be drawn from start to end while fulfilling various rules.

We propose SPaRC, a new dataset to overcome limitations of current datasets, primarily focusing on pathfinding and the combination of arithmetic and geometric rules, such as counting, segregation, and shape logic, by presenting multi-step constraint problems.
outputs: Generated spatial paths for 2D grid puzzles

The generated outputs are paths on 2D grids that satisfy spatial and rule-based constraints, such as connecting start and end points while collecting dots, avoiding gaps, and fulfilling shape and color logic rules.

quote: We compute accuracy (% of solved puzzles) for these models.
We compute accuracy (% of solved puzzles) for these models. We also report pass@k scores and error rates for path violations.

We measure model accuracy on solving our puzzles (Section 4.1), performance on specific rule cells, reasoning errors (Section 4.2), and conduct ablation studies regarding the stability of our findings (Section 4.3).
automatic_metrics: Error Rate (Invalid Path, Incorrect Start/End, Disconnected Line, Intersecting Line, Rule Cell Crossing)

quote: We used six annotators (aged 22-27) with CS backgrounds.
We used six annotators (aged 22-27, with CS backgrounds) to solve 100 i.i.d. drawn puzzles... a puzzle is marked as solved if the majority found a correct solution.
For the manual inspection, we test human performance and time on the same puzzles (Section 4.4). We used six annotators (aged 22-27) with CS backgrounds.
guideline: Rules. The line must connect Start with End with a continuous path without using the same cell twice. It must also follow all rules defined by the puzzle.
Annotators solve each puzzle and a majority vote determines whether the solution is correct.

Annotate all the samples in the dataset in as little time as possible per puzzle. Each puzzle is solvable, but if you can't think of a solution after a reasonable amount of time (5-10 minutes), you can click Show Solution or Skip Puzzle to continue.
